en: Hello {manager}, the cost code {name} has used {used} of its budget: {actual} of {budget}. The forecast for the year is {forecast}. Check: {state}. Please tell me the reason and what we can change.
mt: Hola {manager}, el código de costo {name} ha utilizado {used} de su presupuesto: {actual} de {budget}.

en: Hello, our cash forecast for the month starting {month} shows {closing}, which covers {cover_weeks} weeks of costs. Check: {state}. Please look at sales dates and large payments.
mt: Hola, nuestro pronóstico de efectivo para el mes que comienza con {month} muestra {closing}, que cubre {cover_weeks} semanas de costos.

en: Hello {owner}, {name} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha) shows a profit of {profit} this year, that is {per_ha} per hectare. Check: {state}. Please send me the reasons: yield, price or costs.

en: Hello, the payment {item} of {amount} is due on {due}. Status: {state}. Please prepare the payment and keep the receipt.

en: Hello, policy {pol_id} ({covers}) with {insurer} renews on {renewal}. The premium is {premium}. Please check the values and collect a second quote.
mt: Hola, la póliza {pol_id} ({covers}) con {insurer} se renueva en {renewal}.

en: Hello {officer}, please find our application documents for {scheme} attached. We apply for {applied}. Please confirm that you received everything.
mt: Hola {officer}, por favor encuentre nuestros documentos de solicitud para {scheme} adjuntos.

en: Hello, we report a {event} on {field} on {event_date} under policy {policy}. We claim {claimed}. Please send the claim form and arrange an assessor.

en: Hello {inspector}, we confirm the {kind} on {date}. Scope: {scope}. Please tell us which records you need and we will have them ready.
mt: Por favor, díganos cuáles son los registros que necesita y los tendremos listos.
